units.description: Number of power units (trucks/tractors) registered with FMCSA.

drivers.description: Number of CDL drivers registered with FMCSA.

renewalDate.description: Policy renewal date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD). Present for WC, pension, and welfare/benefits lines.

carrier.description: Insurance carrier name for this line.

broker.description: Broker name. Present for WC, pension, and welfare/benefits lines.

participants.description: Number of covered participants. Only present for pension and welfare/benefits lines.

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

total.description: Total prospects matching the filters across all pages.

totalNetAssets.description: Total net assets at fiscal year end, in USD.

history.description: Up to 11 years of historical IRS total expenses, descending by year. Only present when the requesting user has the csvHasIrsHistoricalData entitlement.

totalExpenses.description: Total expenses for the year, in USD.

ntee.description: NTEE classification code. Only present when the requesting user has the nteeFilter entitlement.

xDatePredictions.description: Modeled renewal-date predictions. Only present when the requesting user has the xDatePredictions entitlement.

benefitsRedFlags.description: Benefits Red Flags (38 risk indicators from Form 5500). Only present when the requesting user has the isBenefitsRedFlagFilter entitlement. Each flag is true (flagged), false (not flagged), or null (insufficient data). Paired benefitsRagFlagDescription* fields carry the explanation when a flag is triggered.

contacts.description: Always null in search response — use /v1/prospects/enrich for contacts

generalLiability.description: Predicted General Liability renewal date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

commercialAuto.description: Predicted Commercial Auto renewal date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).
